author: MLG_Jirafa
body:
I think there was a thread about this before but I can't find it anywhere :/ if anyone can give me a link it'll be fully appreciated

So yeah I have tested a lot of different amounts of fov here is some of my thoughts
Normal: Way to close to things, easy to combo against new people
90: the one that I'm currently using, helps a lot but it's close to things
100/5: My favorite, fast PvP, panoramic view,best for rushing, I'm good comboing with that, the only cons is my internet (I always have more ping than my opponent)
Quake Pro: OHMAIGAHD REACH HACKS RECORDED REPORT!
